overview_description.description:
Foresight was originally created by Taylor Davidson in 2008 as a resource for entrepreneurs to download a simple financial model template for early-stage startups. The reason was simple: Taylor found himself continually creating new financial models for entrepreneur friends of his from scratch, and struggled to find standard templates or resources on the web. He spent one last time building a new financial model for a friend, and then turned it into a template and released it to the public on his website.

After years of modifications, additions, improvements, and new models, Foresight has grown into a more complete resource for financial model templates and standards for entrepreneurs. Over 10,000 people have downloaded one of the financial models and multiple entrepreneurs have raised millions of dollars in venture funding using these templates as a base.

about_short_description.short_description: Better, faster, easier financial models for startups and investors.

product.name: Standard Financial Model Templates
product.description: Spreadsheet templates for budgeting and fundraising, designed for startups and investors to create financial projections and plans.

product.name: Bring Your Own Model (BYOM) Functionality
product.description: A feature allowing users to integrate their own custom revenue and expense forecasts into Foresight's Standard Financial Model.

product.name: Venture Capital Fund Models
product.description: Financial models designed to forecast venture capital fund performance, including portfolio construction, cash flows, and return metrics.

identifier.value: Cap Table and Exit Waterfall Tools

product.name: Cap Table and Exit Waterfall Tools
product.description: Tools and educational resources for modeling capitalization tables and exit waterfalls for startups and investors.

product.name: Custom Financial Modeling Services
product.description: Custom financial modeling services offered on a per-hour or per-project basis for complex or unique business needs.

product.name: Financial Modeling Courses and Education
product.description: Courses and educational materials focused on financial modeling, cap tables, venture funds, and related topics for entrepreneurs and investors.
